en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a richly decorated stone entrance gate with an arched doorway and heavy wooden doors, adorned with carved floral and martial motifs. Above the arch is a triangular pediment with sculpted cannons and a central coat of arms. Through the gate a small courtyard and part of another building façade are visible. At the bottom edge of the image there is printed caption text indicating the location.
